reason: I'd never heard of them, but 60 verified reviews with real install photos, the same on Google, a UL number I can look up and free 30-day returns is more proof than most small shops give me. I'd still google the store first, but at $249 with free returns I'd risk one light.
objection: It's a small unknown store with only 60 reviews, so I'd want to confirm they're legit and that the reviews aren't curated before I put my card in.
would_change_my_mind: Finding a bad pattern in outside reviews (Trustpilot, BBB, Reddit) such as slow refunds or damaged shipments, or a return policy that turned out to have fees or restocking charges.
